extracted.name: Thai Peanut Stir Fry Sauce
extracted.description: The best peanut sauce for stir-fry is easy to prepare using crunchy peanut butter and basic pantry staples for a tasty vegetable or meat stir-fry.
instruction_lines: Combine vinegar, soy sauce, peanut butter, brown sugar, garlic powder, ginger, and cayenne pepper in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook and stir until brown sugar is dissolved and sauce is smooth, about 5 minutes.
